home_intro: Learn German for the integration exam in Austria.
local_note: Your progress is saved on this device only.
tts_failed: Reading aloud is not working on this device right now.
tl_machine_note: Note: the Tagalog translation is machine-made and not reviewed yet.
free_practice_intro: Choose what you want to practise. It does not count for the course – practise as often as you like.
chapter_more_soon: More lessons, the practice part and the chapter test will follow.
pensum_label: How much time do you have per day?
chapter_locked: Locked – finish the chapter before first
review_none: Nothing is due today. New cards appear one day after the lesson.
review_first: Review first, then learn new things.
article_hint: Always write nouns with their article: der, die or das.
flow_gate_note: No lives. You need {min} of {total} right to start the test.
flow_targeted_text: You are not secure on these goals yet:
flow_ready_text: The test has {count} tasks. You have {lives} lives. Every mistake costs one life. Without mistakes you pass the chapter at once. With mistakes a correction round follows.
flow_correction_text: Every mistake gets a similar task. A mistake here means: the chapter again.
flow_review_text: The chapter was not secure yet. First answer every error card right once. Then a new attempt starts.
flow_rk6_title: Most of your mistakes were here:
flow_rk6_text: Get help: in the ÖIF course room and, once available, in the question chat.
flow_bonus: Perfect! You start the next chapter with {count} bonus lives.
flow_next_soon: This chapter is still being written. Until then: review and free practice.
flow_demo_note: This is the demo: a small version of the flow. Your course progress stays untouched.
review_errors_done: Error cards done – on to the words.
free_mode: Free mode: own progress, does not count for the course.
settings_unlock_note: Chapters that are not due yet run in free mode with their own progress. The course itself keeps its order.
settings_translations: Show the translation under German titles
settings_reset_note: Deletes profile, chapters and reviews on this device.
install_ios: Use it as an app: in Safari tap “Share”, then “Add to Home Screen”.
